description: Calf breeds for salers dams January to June 2011 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Rural Payments Agency. This includes Animals born to Saler & Saler X dams only and GB born cattle only, as reported to the Rural Payments Agency. Attribution statement: © Rural Payments Agency. Coverage: United Kingdom. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
